## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional commit title (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `ci:`, `chore:`, `deps:` ...)
- [ ] New third-party actions are pinned to a full commit SHA with a `# vX.Y.Z` comment
- [ ] Workflow `permissions` are least privilege
- [ ] No secrets or long-lived credentials added
- [ ] Docs / README walkthrough updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] Terraform plan reviewed (if `terraform/` changed)
